"use server"
// PROBE — compliant control for tests/unit/agent-action-input-validation.test.ts.
import { db } from "@/lib/db"
import { AddPolicyForCustomerInput, validationFailure } from "@/lib/validations/agent-intake"

export async function addPolicyProbe(data: unknown) {
    const parsed = AddPolicyForCustomerInput.safeParse(data)
    if (!parsed.success) return validationFailure(parsed.error)
    const created = await db.policy.create({
        data: { ownerUserId: parsed.data.customerId, startDate: new Date(parsed.data.policy.startDate) },
    })
    return { success: true, policyId: created.id }
}
